families.title: Score identity, metadata, version and clipboard
families.reason: Metadata fields need distinct sentinels and explicit GP8 conversion decisions.

families.title: Page, track and beat display metadata
families.reason: Display data needs true, false, enum, and target-loss checks.

families.title: Track, staff, bar and voice ownership
families.reason: Ordered ownership and compatibility views need path-sensitive checks.

families.title: Tuning, capo and instrument context
families.reason: Pitch context needs boundary, precedence, and sounding-pitch checks.

families.title: MIDI routing, mixer, RSE and selectable sounds
families.reason: Playback routing needs distinct values and reference checks.

families.title: Tempo values, authority and visibility
families.reason: Tempo sources need explicit authority, precision, and visibility checks.

families.title: Measures, keys, repeats and directions
families.reason: Master-bar semantics need enum, count, and numeric-boundary checks.

families.title: Durations, exact time and pickup behavior
families.reason: Rhythm needs exact arithmetic, boundary, and idempotence checks.

families.title: Note pitch, kind and source representation
families.reason: Pitch values need source-spelling, range, and tie checks.

families.title: Beat status, dynamics, text and chord-wide effects
families.reason: Beat semantics need status, dynamic, enum, and effect checks.

families.title: Per-note techniques and enum completeness
families.reason: Each note technique needs independent source and target evidence.

families.title: Bend and whammy conversion limits
families.reason: Curve preservation needs shape, range, and loss-policy checks.

families.title: Harmonics and pitch spelling
families.reason: Harmonic kinds and authored pitch spelling need distinct checks.

families.title: Chord definitions, fingering and per-occurrence editing
families.reason: Chord scope and mutable occurrence data need complete field checks.

families.title: Ordered grace notes
families.reason: Grace order, identity, and authored values need occurrence checks.

families.title: Percussion identity and instrument definitions
families.reason: Percussion identity needs notation and playback checks beyond MIDI equality.

families.title: Automations and sound references
families.reason: Ordered automation data needs dispatch, reference, and range checks.

families.title: Lyrics and text scopes
families.reason: Score, track, and beat text need separate scope checks.

families.title: Backing assets and synchronization
families.reason: Assets and sync points need identity, unit, and omission checks.

families.title: Source audit and malformed but decodable input
families.reason: Every decoded source leaf and dispatch needs a tested disposition.

families.title: Shared validation and read-only contracts
families.reason: Authored invariants and mutation boundaries need shared checks.

families.title: Combined features and compatibility
families.reason: Selected interactions need bounded path-sensitive checks.

families.title: Whole-corpus semantic accounting
families.reason: Every fixture needs feature-level semantic evidence or a narrow tracked gap.

families.title: Oracle correctness
families.reason: Adapters and comparators need enum and ownership sensitivity checks.

families.title: Mutation sensitivity and structural fuzzing
families.reason: Coverage claims need deterministic defect and structure checks.

cases.oracle: Hand-authored GPIF decoded by an independent XML token extractor.
limitations: GPIF has no separate Writer, Comments, or Date element.

cases.oracle: Actual upstream score-info fixtures with pinned AlphaTab metadata values.
limitations: AlphaTab does not expose legacy Writer separately from GPIF Music.

cases.oracle: Independent XML token extraction plus Go reimport.
limitations: Writer, Comments, Date, and clipboard ranges are reported omissions.
Source version, notice item boundaries, score key, and score triplet feel are reported normalizations.

cases.oracle: Hand-authored little-endian clipboard record.
Pinned AlphaTab Score.music adapter contract.
limitations: AlphaTab exposes GPIF Music but not a separate binary Writer field.

cases.oracle: Independent GPIF XML extraction and binary layout flag extraction.
limitations: Page setup, marker color, voice direction, beat display, line breaks, and most track display settings are reported omissions.

cases.oracle: Actual upstream GP5 score-info fixture and pinned AlphaTab string framing grammar.
limitations: The public model retains visibility as the original bit mask.

values: two staves before and after one staff
cases.oracle: Hand-authored GPIF plus an independent XML token extractor and the pinned AlphaTab ownership grammar.
Direct alias, deep-value, and GP8 reimport checks.
limitations: A non-nil legacy compatibility slice is authoritative for staff 0.

cases.oracle: Pinned AlphaTab vertical track and staff traversal grammar.

values: non-default fret count, port, track flags, and staff lines
cases.oracle: Independent tuning-plus-fret MIDI calculation, pinned AlphaTab capo grammar, and GP8 reimport.
limitations: GP8 omits legacy fret-count, port, twelve-string, and banjo fields. Custom pitched staff line counts are also omitted.

cases.oracle: Independent GPIF leaf extraction and GP8 reimport.
limitations: GP8 omits bank and effect controllers plus legacy master and track RSE records.

cases.oracle: Independent reference-factor values, GPIF leaf extraction, and GP8 reimport.
limitations: GP8 writer emits the opening tempo as visible and reports a hidden source tempo as omitted.

cases.oracle: Independent GPIF token and attribute extraction plus GP8 reimport.
limitations: GP8 omits legacy directions, header-local tempo, and authored meter beam groupings.

cases.oracle: Hand-authored GPIF master bars and checked public-model validation.
limitations: Master-bar key and meter values are authoritative over compatibility measure values.

values: invalid note, dot, and ratio terms
cases.oracle: Independent GPIF rhythm token and attribute extraction plus GP8 reimport.
limitations: GP8 normalizes simultaneous dot flags and the 0:0 legacy default tuplet representation.

cases.oracle: Exact rational arithmetic with hand-calculated starts and a deep independent snapshot.
Independent GPIF property and tie extraction plus GP8 reimport.
limitations: GP8 omits the legacy accidental-swap preference and per-note duration percentage.

cases.oracle: Shared public-model diagnostics and export rejection reports.
limitations: An unbound tie can begin outside an imported excerpt, so it is diagnostic but remains encodable.

values: beat dynamic distinct from note velocity
cases.oracle: Independent GPIF leaf extraction plus GP8 reimport.
limitations: GP8 normalizes an explicit empty beat to a rest and quantizes note velocities to one beat dynamic.

values: fade-in, rasgueado, vibrato, and non-default stroke duration
cases.oracle: Independent GPIF leaf extraction, direct source-dispatch results, and GP8 reimport.
limitations: GP8 omits rasgueado, pick stroke, slap/pop/tap, and beat vibrato. It normalizes stroke duration to an eighth note.

features.reason: The full corpus parses, while richer metadata and loss reporting remain tracked by issues 12 and 13.
Selected duration, dot, tuplet, time-signature, and rest cases are compared; exact score time and the remaining authored rhythm model are tracked by issues 12 and 15.
Selected absolute display starts agree after zero-origin normalization; exact score time and shared finalized-graph validation are tracked by issues 14 and 15.
The grand-staff contract compares exact track, staff, bar, voice, beat, and note hierarchy plus authored contents; broader model ownership and legacy projection are tracked by issue 12.
Selected authored ownership and source-fret cases agree after excluding display duration and playback pitch; complete cross-format grace coverage is tracked by issue 12.
The canonical contract inventories these fields; a lossless semantic model is tracked by issue 12.
Binary and GPIF tremolo-picking subdivisions are retained on notes; all six GPIF fixture beats agree with AlphaTab.
GPIF HFret values and common harmonic kinds are compared on import and GP8 export; distinctions that the legacy model collapses are tracked by issue 12.
All eight GPIF hairpins and GP8 Decrescendo output agree with AlphaTab; legacy Diminuendo input remains accepted.
GPIF references 1–5 and absent or invalid defaults agree after BPM normalization; authored units, text, visibility, and interpolation remain part of issue 12.
GP7–8 GPIF articulation identity, per-track definitions, notation metadata, input values, and output MIDI are compared; cross-format semantic integration is tracked by issue 12.
